messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — planning a rollforward for Helios onprem staging this Thu 10:00 PT. Goal: deploy 2.14.1, run egress smoke, and validate KV cache warmup. I put the tentative checklist in the runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/helios-rollforward
kevin: ACK. What's the current blocker list? I thought cert rotation was already done?
anya: Certs for the admin API are rotated, but the client-side certs on their airgapped gateway still need the new CA chain. Waiting on their infra team to sign the CSR.
elaine: Firewall rule ask: we still need L4 egress to telemetry.redwood.ai:443 from the bastion hosts. Helios ops said they can open it, but asked for exact CIDRs and ports.
anya: @elaine — CIDRs: 10.12.0.0/22 (bastion fleet), ports 443 outbound. Also we need TCP 9411 for tracing -> optional but recommended.
kevin: On the certs — I've got a small script they can run in the airgapped environment to generate the CSR and bundle the CA. Paste below:
```
# on customer bastion
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout helios-client.key -out helios-client.csr -subj "/CN=helios-client"
# transfer CSR to their sig team, then import signed cert as helios-client.crt
```
kevin: I can pair with their infra tomorrow morning to sign if they share the CSR file in the transfer bucket.
tom: FYI there's a pending CR in github: github.com/redwood/serving/pull/3842 — it fixes a KV cache desync we saw in canary. CI is green but needs a second review from eng-runtime. @kevin can you take a look?
kevin: on it, will review tonight. If we merge, we should tag a patch and include in the rollforward. Any objections?
elaine: No objections, but we need to coordinate a quick canary step before broad rollout. Maybe deploy to 2 canaries and validate latency + error rates for 30m.
anya: Agreed. Roll plan: 1) snapshot staging 2) deploy CR patch to canaries 3) run egress and cert checks 4) full rollout. Can we get the canary window 10:20–10:50 PT?
ops-bot: Deployment job helios-staging-rollforward queued by anya — job id dj-2026-4423. Status: queued.
kevin: Can we also add a quick smoke script to validate prefix caching? I have a small curl loop we ran earlier. I'll drop it into the runbook in 5m.
tom: Also: remind the support rotation that during canary we might see transient 5xxs — escalate to eng-runtime. @support-lead plz note.
anya: Good call. I updated the runbook with owners and callouts. Final ask: if the customer's sig team can't sign the CSR by Wed EOD, we postpone to next week. Please ping once you get confirmation so I can lock the schedule.
kevin: I'll ping them now and post back here.
elaine: I'll send the exact firewall ACL snippet to their network team and Cc you, anya.
tom: I'll follow up on the CR review and post any blocking comments.
anya: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the source of truth for the rollforward cadence. :rocket:
